integrity: The proof starts from independently inspected published formulas, explicitly credits the previously known Fourier-series positivity representation, and claims novelty only for the exact summation, structural multiplier consequences, and relativistic threshold-gap coefficient.
scientific_limitations: Applies only under the planar weak-bending hypotheses of the cited zigzag-Dirac result. The rational multiplier bounds are not claimed optimal, and the source remainder is not improved.
title: Closed Fourier multiplier for weak-bending zigzag-Dirac binding
